blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Quezon City government advised motorists to temporarily use alternative routes as heavy traffic is expected on Friday, Oct. 9, during the procession of the image of Our Lady of La Naval De Manila. The city government said in an advisory that traffic build is expected from 7 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Friday due to the scheduled recorrido, or religious procession. READ: Remembering the old ‘La Naval’ It said the procession will begin at Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal Parish and will proceed to the Quezon City Hall, and end at Sto. Domingo Church.
